The preview version has since been retired and the October 29 release is the active model, so anyone still pointing at preview weights should move. Mistral announced a collaboration with NVIDIA on AI-native engineering, using Mistral Large 4 alongside simulation and physics pipelines and NVIDIA accelerated computing. # Mistral Large 4 (Le Chonk): Open Weights, License, Price and Benchmarks

By Lenka Vojtechova  ·  Updated November 7, 2026  ·  12 min read

AI NewsMistralOpen-Source ModelLLMAI Coding

Thumbnail reading [...] Thumbnail reading 

Mistral Large 4, nicknamed Le Chonk, is a 1-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 49 billion active parameters. Mistral AI released it as a public preview API on October 6, 2026, then shipped an improved final version and the open weights on October 29. It reads text and images, answers in text, and now costs $0.70 per million input tokens. [...] Yes. Mistral released the weights on Hugging Face on October 29, 2026, two days after the date it gave reporters. They cover the improved final model, and come with an NVFP4 checkpoint for NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs. The licence is the Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight license, a modified MIT licence.

 

How much does Mistral Large 4 cost?

$0.70 per million input tokens and $2.10 per million output tokens, with cached input at $0.07, since October 29, 2026. The preview listed at $1.36 and $4.18.

On 20 October 2026, Crédit Agricole Artificial Intelligence announced a partnership that involves Mistral in building the group's AI platform, beyond access to its models: an agent for retail banking clients, agentic processes, and cybersecurity, presented as "a major focus". The announcements from BNP Paribas and HSBC, already partners of Mistral, do not mention cybersecurity. The announcement sets no amount, duration, model, or exclusivity.

STStephane Nachez · ·4 min [...] The 20 October release cites three workstreams: a conversational agent for clients of the group's retail banks, the "agentic transformation of key processes", and cybersecurity. Crédit Agricole Artificial Intelligence runs the group's AI foundations. With Mistral's technology, it also plans to adapt large language models to its data and use cases. The release sees this as a way to optimise performance, "and therefore the consumption of computing resources and its environmental impact". [...] The 20 October release gives no amount, no commitment duration, no timeline for the client agent, and cites no particular Mistral model. It also says nothing about any exclusivity. The pattern recalls that observed with Mistral at EDF, BMW, or Airbus: partnerships announced, rarely quantified. The announcement comes six weeks after the lab's 3 billion euro fundraising.

# Meeting Briefing: Mistral AI

**Date & Time:** 2026-11-20T10:00:00+05:30  
**Subject:** Strategic Alignment & Recent Developments Review

---

## ## Recent developments
* **Launch of Mistral Large 4 ("Le Chonk"):** Mistral AI released its flagship model family in late October 2026 (following an initial October preview). It is a native multimodal, 1-trillion-parameter mixture-of-experts model featuring roughly 49 billion active parameters [1, 3]. 
* **Open Weights and Licensing:** Open weights were published on Hugging Face on October 29, 2026, accompanied by an NVFP4 checkpoint for NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs and the custom *Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight license* (a modified MIT license) [3]. API pricing is set at $0.70 per million input tokens and $2.10 per million output tokens [3].
* **NVIDIA Engineering Collaboration:** Announced on October 21, 2026, Mistral partnered with NVIDIA to integrate Mistral Large 4 into AI-native engineering, physics pipelines, and simulation workflows to support industrial buyers with secure on-premise design data [1].
* **Enterprise & Cybersecurity Partnerships:** 
  * Crédit Agricole announced a partnership on October 20, 2026, utilizing Mistral technology for retail banking assistants, agentic process transformation, and cybersecurity [4].
  * Orange Cyberdefense became a design partner in November 2026 to integrate Mistral Large 4 into security services such as penetration testing and incident response [5].

## ## Talking points
* **Mistral Large 4 & Sovereignty:** Discuss how self-hosting capabilities and the new open weights address data sovereignty and compliance requirements for enterprise and security workloads [1, 2, 5].
* **Industrial & Engineering Use Cases:** Explore opportunities to leverage the NVIDIA accelerated computing collaboration for simulation and physics-based pipelines [1].
* **Ecosystem Licensing:** Review the terms and implications of the *Mistral Ecosystem Open-Weight license* for downstream product deployment [1, 3].
* **Agentic Workflows:** Inquire about best practices for deploying Mistral Large 4 in complex, multi-step agentic coding and security automation contexts [1].

## ## Open questions
* What are the recommended migration paths or technical considerations for teams transitioning from the retired October preview weights to the final active release [1]?
* How are enterprise clients balancing API consumption vs. local self-hosting deployments for Mistral Large 4, particularly given the new pricing structure ($0.70/M input tokens) [3]?
* What is the roadmap for expanding specialized design partnerships (such as the Orange Cyberdefense collaboration) into broader vertical markets [5]?

## ## Sources
* [1] [Open Source AI Models: 3 Run Paths, 48% Index [2026]](https://shattered.io/open-source-ai-models-3-run-paths-mistral-large-4-kimi-k3-1-glm-5-3-2026)
* [2] [Mistral AI Releases Large 4 Model for Cybersecurity Use Globally](https://www.globalbankingandfinance.com/mistral-ai-publicly-releases-large-4-targets-cybersecurity)
* [3] [Mistral Large 4: Open Weights, License, Price, Benchmarks](https://felloai.com/mistral-large-4)
* [4] [Crédit Agricole partners with Mistral AI on platform](https://www.actuia.com/en/news/frances-credit-agricole-taps-mistral-ai-to-build-its-ai-platform)
* [5] [Orange Cyberdefense becomes Mistral AI design partner for cybersecurity – MSP Business](https://mspbusiness.com/en/market-and-strategy/orange-cyberdefense-becomes-mistral-ai-design-partner-for-cybersecurity)
